By sending their {GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept.Hyperlink} a {GLOBAL.DiplomaticTokenConcept.Hyperlink}, the {GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept.Hyperlink} of the {GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.Hyperlink} with that {GLOBAL.EmpireConcept.Hyperlink} will improve over time.[br/][br/]Higher {GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept.Hyperlink} leads to better diplomatic states with more valuable benefits. This [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept]negotiation process[/hyperlink] is divided into the {GLOBAL.NegotiationPhaseConcept.Hyperlink} and the {GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept.Hyperlink}, which eventually leads to the {GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept.Hyperlink}.
